title: Token
description: A bearer token bound to one actor (docs/design/m0/04 "Actors and tokens"). The secret is shown once, at issue, and never stored: the record keeps only its argon2id hash, in the PHC string format. The bearer presents tok_<id>.<secret>; the id finds this record and the hash verifies the secret.

hash.description: argon2id over the secret: $argon2id$v=19$m=<KiB>,t=<passes>,p=<lanes>$<salt>$<key>, a 16-byte salt and a 32-byte key in canonical base64 without padding. internal/identity also requires the cost within its bounds and m >= 8p (RFC 9106).
